messages:
anna: Heads up — preparing to publish py/ts SDK canary for signer rotation + dist-tag change. Change window 22:00 UTC. Need (1) QA signoff, (2) pin strategy for older clients, (3) release notes draft.

mike: SG. I'll run smoke + integration. Which dist-tags are we using? canary->next first, then latest?

anna: Plan: publish -> run smoke -> rotate `next` -> wait observation window -> flip `latest` if healthy. For pip we'll publish pre-release (rc) wheels. Sequence documented below.

deploy-bot: publish started: job/py-ts-canary-publish (id: 3344556880)

sophia: FYI saw a packaging checksum flake last night (missing metadata). Fix merged in #ci. @mike can you verify wheel sha before tag flip?

mike: On it. I'll upload the wheel and post sha256. Command I used: `python -m pip wheel . -w dist/ && shasum -a 256 dist/*.whl`

ben: We should pin older major (v1.x) to a `legacy` dist-tag to avoid accidental pulls. Rollback plan should be explicit: retag latest->previous, yank wheels if needed.

anna: Rollback steps (short):
1) `npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk latest`
2) `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@<previous> latest`
3) yank bad wheel from PyPI (if required) and update changelog with notice.
I'll put a checklist in the release notes.

sophia: QA running e2e against canary on dedicated infra. If latency/regressions < 5% we can consider flip. ETA ~30m.

mike: Wheel uploaded to staging. sha256: `3f2a9b8d7e4c1f2a9b8c...` (shortened). Verified match on staging host.

deploy-bot: publish succeeded: job/py-ts-canary-publish (id: 3344556885)

sophia: Smoke suite passed. One flaky retry-backoff assertion hit once, but not blocking. @anna do we want another canary run or proceed to observation window?

anna: Decision: proceed to 1h observation on `next` before flipping `latest`. If we see regressions >1% or errors >0.5% we abort and roll back. Also adding deprecation note for sync client in changelog. Drafting now.

ben: Reminder: update SDK docs + quickstart snippets for the new call signatures before the flip. Also pin integration consumers to `legacy` where appropriate.

mike: CI: removed old sync client gating flag — integration tests now run with `--use-async-client`. Confirmed no failures.

anna: I'll post announcement to #devex and #general after `latest` flip and ping CS with the deprecation blurb.

sophia: Follow-ups I will create: rollback issue, add signer-rotation checklist to release-playbook, run an additional canary on dedicated nodes at ~30m.

mike: Artifacts stored at: `gs://redwood-releases/py-ts/3344556677/` (wheels + tarballs + sha256s).

anna: :thumbsup: proceeding to observation window. If you see something bad react with :x: to this thread and call it out.

sophia: Will monitor and report back in 30m.

ben: I'll start drafting the deprecation email for affected customers — sharing copy once ready.
